_source: Client presentation meta per project-type key, transcribed VERBATIM from pototype/project-types.jsx PROJECT_TYPES (L6-51). GET /project-types omits these 5 fields (nameEn / desc / icon / color / costTypes) — they are product-level presentation config, not tenant data — so the card reads them here, keyed by the server row's `key`. color is a prototype-verbatim per-type hex used for the card borderTop / icon-box color-mix / cost-tag (B-037: literal allowed — copied verbatim, no matching @juneflow/tokens token). icon is a ds.jsx Icon name. Kept in .json so Thai (desc / costTypes) never appears in the .tsx source (i18n-guard skips .json).
